description: This file defines a React component for the leaderboard page in a Next.js frontend application. It manages state, fetches data via API calls, and renders a UI with contributor rankings and activity feeds.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to restrict a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: formatContributorLabel
methods.description: Formats a contributor label by trimming whitespace and providing a default for empty labels.

methods.name: contributorKey
methods.description: Generates a stable unique key for a contributor based on username, email, or defaults to 'unknown'.

methods.name: contributorLabel
methods.description: Returns the contributor label based on available username or email, defaults to 'Unknown'.

methods.name: LeaderboardPage
methods.description: Main React component for the leaderboard page, managing data fetching, user interactions, and display logic.
